result.subject: Consolidated project estimate attached
result.body:
Hello —

I'm attaching the consolidated project estimate workbook and a separate FINAL file that contains the verified Final sheet for reporting.

Please use the FINAL file for any submissions.

Thanks,
City Planner

(See attachments: Consolidated_Project_Estimate.xlsx and Consolidated_Project_FINAL.xlsx and a short readme.)

attachments.name: Consolidated_Project_Estimate.xlsx
attachments.content:
Sheet: Final
Total Project Cost: $12,500,000
Contingency: $500,000
Approved Fees: $300,000
Net: $12,500,000
(Workbook contains many sheets; the 'Final' sheet in this workbook was accidentally overwritten by a bulk copy.)

attachments.name: Consolidated_Project_FINAL.xlsx
attachments.content:
Sheet: Final
Total Project Cost: $11,200,000
Contingency: $400,000
Approved Fees: $300,000
Net: $11,200,000
(This is the verified Final sheet to be used for official submissions.)

attachments.name: estimate_readme.txt
attachments.content: NOTE: A bulk copy accidentally replaced the 'Final' sheet in Consolidated_Project_Estimate.xlsx. The correct verified final figures are in Consolidated_Project_FINAL.xlsx. Use that file for official submissions.
